verdict.rationale: Daytona sandboxes are isolated, ephemeral runtime environments explicitly designed for AI agents to execute code without touching production systems, with network/firewall isolation preventing data exfiltration and instant spin-up/teardown so tests never persist beyond the sandbox lifecycle. This directly matches the story of testing in an isolated environment separate from production. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation contrasting sandbox vs 'production' data separation, and no independent/hands-on validation of isolation guarantees beyond vendor docs.
